title: Unified Payments Interface (UPI) – ZX Bank Asia

nodes.title: 💡 What is UPI?
nodes.summary: Explains UPI as a real-time payment system enabling instant 24x7 money transfers from a mobile device, with a single app for multiple bank accounts, transfers by mobile number, Virtual Payment Address (VPA), or QR codes, and usage for fund transfer, bill payments, and merchant payments.

nodes.title: 📱 How to Activate UPI with ZX Bank
nodes.summary: 7 activation steps: download the ZX Bank Asia app, login/register with the ZX Bank mobile number and e-KYC, open the UPI section, create or link a UPI ID (VPA) like yourname@zxbank, link the ZX Bank account, set/reset a 4/6-digit UPI PIN authenticated by debit card, and start transacting, paying bills, and scanning QR codes.

nodes.title: 🏦 UPI Daily Limits with ZX Bank
nodes.summary: Per-transaction limit of ₹1,00,000, per-day total limit of ₹1,00,000 across all UPI transactions, and a maximum of 20 transfers per day; limits follow NPCI and ZX Bank policy and may vary by customer risk profile.

nodes.title: 🛠️ UPI Customer Support
nodes.summary: Support via the in-app Help & Support > UPI section, customer care 1800-XXX-XXXX (toll-free in India), email upi.support@zxbank.asia, or the 'Zia' AI assistant; notes UPI is currently available only in India, with dedicated remittance options for cross-border payments.
